title: Operational metrics
provisionedDescription: Everyone created in Track the Hack, whether or not they attended.
confirmedDescription: People who confirmed that they planned to attend.
checkedInDescription: Unique people with recorded evidence that they attended.
walkInDescription: Participants registered as walk-ins, whether or not attendance has been recorded.
presencesDescription: Recorded units across check-in, food, merchandise, and event attendance. A person may contribute more than once.
funnelDescription: The people pipeline uses aggregate application snapshots and live Tracker totals. Each step shows its conversion rate and the number of people who did not reach the next stage.
conversionDetail: {{from}} started · {{to}} reached the next stage · {{dropOff}} drop-off
conversionUnavailable: The source snapshot for this conversion has not been synced.
applicationsDescription: Completed application rows in the restricted Google Sheet at the last aggregate sync.
acceptedDescription: Application rows currently marked Accepted at the last aggregate sync.
acceptanceEmailsDescription: Acceptance messages AWS SES accepted for delivery. This does not prove inbox delivery and may count more than one message per person.
devpostProjectsDescription: Projects in the latest judging roster imported from Devpost.
devpostDescription: Aggregate Devpost organizer snapshot from {{time}}. Personal details are used only during the local match and are not stored in Tracker.
devpostRegistrantsDescription: People registered for the event on Devpost.
devpostActiveRegistrantsDescription: Registrants counted as active in Devpost's organizer metrics.
devpostSubmittersDescription: People included on a submitted project, including team members.
devpostSubmittedProjectsDescription: Public and hidden submitted projects; drafts are excluded.
demographicsDescription: Aggregate-only Sheet snapshot from {{time}}. Categories with fewer than five applicants are combined as Other / suppressed; no application rows or personal details are stored in Tracker.

dimension.acquisitionChannel: How applicants heard about Hack the Hill

dataQualityDescription: Coverage and reconciliation checks identify where funnel counts may be incomplete or where source systems disagree.
sheetUnlinkedRows: Application rows not linked to Tracker
devpostApplicationMatches: Devpost registrants matched to an application
devpostUnmatchedRegistrants: Devpost registrants without an exact application email match
devpostMatchedSubmitters: Matched application identities on a submitted team
devpostProjectImportGap: Public Devpost projects missing from the judging roster
uniqueAttendanceDescription: Each participant is counted at most once per event.
recordedUnitsDescription: The sum of recorded values. Food, merchandise, or repeatable workflows may count a person more than once.
eventEngagementDescription: Known attendees grouped by the number of distinct non-check-in activities with a positive presence record.
integrityAttention: One or more attendance checks need attention.
positivePresenceWithoutCheckIn: Positive event presences missing Known-attendee status
mealCategoryDescription: All provisioned participants; this is not limited to people currently known to have attended.
tShirtSizeDescription: All provisioned participants; this is not limited to people currently known to have attended.
